purpose: Evaluate normalized variant identity, callset fitness, statistical-genetics assumptions, and clinical claim boundaries.

cases.task: Reconcile one indel across VCF, annotation, population and clinical sources.
must_include: build coordinate REF ALT and normalization
separate frequency prediction and assertion rows

cases.task: Assess whether a cohort VCF is fit for downstream interpretation.
must_include: identity sex contamination and relatedness checks
missingness depth quality and filter review

cases.task: Review a locus association and credible set.
must_not: name a causal gene from proximity alone
treat the lead SNP as proven causal

cases.task: Interpret molecular QTL and disease colocalization.
must_include: datasets LD priors and signal handling

cases.task: Review predictive transfer or causal-inference evidence.
Handle a request to apply a variant database label to one person.
must_not: recommend screening treatment or family action
present database assertion as clinical sign-out

cases.task: Select database and optional calling backends for a variant evidence task.
must_include: build allele transcript and population fields
backend version query and failure provenance
must_not: let an aggregator replace allele normalization
run variant calling from an interpretation request
treat a database label as personal clinical advice
